summary: Firefox improves layout sizing in CSS Grid, flexbox, and subgrids, and fixes cases where text clamping or inline content could lead to incorrect layout. Scrolling behavior also gets a broad round of fixes: sticky positioning works more reliably with anchor scrolling, scroll snapping accounts for content fragments, and restoring a page’s position avoids unnecessary scroll events. Other changes improve accessibility handling and caret placement, while several internal cleanups make frame layout and state restoration more robust.
